sql: select series, date_trunc('week', captured_at)::date as wk, count(distinct market_ticker) as mkts, round(min(hours_to_close)::numeric,0) as min_htc, round(max(hours_to_close)::numeric,0) as max_htc, max(volume) as max_vol, count(distinct market_ticker) filter (where mid between 5 and 10) as in_band from mmsell_candidate_ticks where series in ('KXFEDMENTION','KXSECPRESSMENTION','KXMAMDANIMENTION','KXWCMENTION') group by 1,2 order by 1,2
